title: Segmentation Models Overview
summary: This module provides a comprehensive collection of models designed for various image and video segmentation tasks, including universal, instance, and text-guided segmentation, as well as video object tracking.

nodes.title: Universal Segmentation Models

nodes.label: SAM-based Segmentation Models
nodes.title: SAM-based Segmentation Models
nodes.description: Models built upon the Segment Anything Model (SAM) architecture, extended for tasks like text-guided image segmentation and video object tracking.
